title: Microsoft Copilot: ask about highlighted text in a response
summary: Hold: the briefing understates the controls that govern Copilot prompts and responses, despite Microsoft's documented enterprise protections. The roadmap facts and app-blocking path are supported, but the broad claims that no admin setting is documented and only the whole-app block governs the feature need narrowing.
